title: Bootleg records and Wally Heider
summary: He has about 25 bootleg LPs of his broadcasts, V-discs and transcriptions and feels flattered rather than aggrieved.

story.theme_name: Getting paid for records: royalties, publishing and flat fees
story.community_name: Royalties, publishing and who owns the song

blocks.x: Yeah. Of course most of the stuff, they say the best is yet to come, that's all available on these bootlegs now, so that may be one reason they stopped him, because those bootleg people have just about covered every aspect, including a lot of things that I don't even remember. Well, they've got old Coca Cola programs problems, V-discs, transcriptions, radio broadcasts and everything they put out. There's a fellow over in England that does a tremendous job in making fairly good quality out of them. He's put out two of these things, and I couldn't believe the quality, because these are just plain, right off the air broadcasts, and they were done at a time when there was no tape, so they had to have been direct to an acetate, and the quality of what went out over the air those days, what he's been able to do has been just remarkable. You can even hear the bass, you know, and that's usually missing on the --
Yeah. Are those records being sold -- I suppose they are -- in this country?

Oh, you find them all around in the places like Tower Records and things like that. I guess [warehouse (a store)] Warehouse. I haven't been in a Warehouse, but I guess they probably have them too. They've got a big bin of them there. I've got 25 of those things in my possession, all bootlegs.
Wow. There's no way you can ever get anything from them?

There isn't that much involved, because there's all different people, and if you could track them down how are you going to get accounts and, actually if you want to get right down to it, I'm very flattered that anybody would want to hear all these old things.
And I don't have all of them.
Wally Heider is putting out air checks -- no, not air checks, radio transcriptions, right? Isn't that what he has of yours?
I don't know. He was down to my house, trying to find something I had that hadn't already been put out by one of these people, but we couldn't find anything.
